channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: LPGA Highlights 2026: Honda LPGA Thailand, Round 2
item.description: Celebrating her 23rd birthday Friday, Jeeno Thitikul shot a 9-under 63 Friday and moved into second place at the Siam Country Club Old Course near Bangkok.

item.title: Down 35 pounds, Aldrich Potgieter starting to adjust to mass change
item.description: After several months overhauling his training and diet, the 21-year-old, hard-hitting South African is down about 35 pounds from where he ended last season.

item.title: Cognizant Classic features 121-player field but no Rory McIlroy or Scottie Scheffler
item.description: Rory McIlroy is eschewing the Cognizant Classic in favor of a return to Augusta as he readies for his Masters title defense. Here's a list of players who have committed to the first leg of the Tour's "East Coast swing."

item.title: Schauffele survives Thursday, flourishes Friday at Genesis
item.description: After a slow start on a difficult Day 1 at the 2026 Genesis Invitational, Xander Schauffele moved near the top of the leaderboard on Day 2. He talks about the difference and what he expects over the weekend at Riviera.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler survives cut at Genesis Invitational, sits 12 strokes off lead
item.description: Scottie Scheffler did not finish within 10 strokes of Marco Penge and Jacob Bridgeman at Riviera Country Club but did make it to the weekend thanks to being inside the top 50 in the 72-player field.

item.title: Genesis Invitational 2026: Round 3 tee times, pairings, and how to watch
item.description: Chris Gotterup and Justin Rose, a pair of 2026 PGA Tour winners, have missed the cut at the Genesis Invitational. Here's a look at who made it, when they're playing Saturday at Riviera Country Club, and how to watch.

item.title: Rory McIlroy chasing Marco Penge, Jacob Bridgeman entering weekend at Genesis Invitational
item.description: Marco Penge and Jacob Bridgeman had superb finishes at Riviera on Friday, each with a 7-under 64 that left them tied for the lead at the Genesis Invitational with Rory McIlroy right on their heels.

item.title: McIlroy avoids costly errors in bogey-free second round at Riviera
item.description: Rory McIlroy saved par on a few holes during his back-nine at Riviera Country Club which helped secure a 6-under 65 on Friday afternoon. The bogey-free second round has the world's No. 2-ranked player one stroke off the Genesis Invitational heading into the weekend.

item.title: Got a chance? Scheffler fights for cut and two more rounds
item.description: Scottie Scheffler saved par on his final hole Friday to make the cut at the Genesis Invitational. Can he pull off the improbable -- again -- and challenge over the weekend?

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: Genesis Invitational, Round 2
item.description: Highlights from the second round of the Genesis Invitational at Riviera Country Club, where Marco Penge and Jacob Bridgeman lead the way with Rory McIlroy giving chase and Scottie Scheffler surviving the cut line.
